fields.name: Eloralintide / EloraTZP
fields.stage: Eloralintide Phase 3 ongoing; EloraTZP Phase 2b results reported
fields.summary: Lilly's 30 September 2026 release reports a completed 48-week Phase 2b study of eloralintide plus tirzepatide in 367 adults with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes. Eloralintide monotherapy Phase 3 trials are ongoing; EloraTZP co-formulation Phase 3 trials were planned for Q4 2026 and are not treated as started.
fields.limitations: Sponsor-reported efficacy-estimate results are not regulatory approval or a cross-trial comparison. The Phase 2b study used separate injections, while the planned Phase 3 product is a co-formulation. Gastrointestinal events were more frequent in combination arms and adverse-event discontinuation ranged from 10.8% to 27.0%.
